_note: Part G: distinct scenes for the 10 look-alike college Dans (set as prompt_override + shield_override in the Ask Dan Image Studio).
dan_college_berkeley: Berkeley College Sunday brunch: Dan wears a white chef's apron over his navy Berkeley College sweater and a little chef's hat, proudly flipping a tall stack of pancakes on a griddle in a sunny, wood-paneled college dining hall, maple syrup bottle beside him, students blurred in the background.
dan_college_branford: High up inside Harkness Tower's carillon bell chamber above Branford College: Dan in a maroon-and-navy Branford College sweater stands at the wooden carillon keyboard, one paw on a baton key, huge bronze bells overhead, golden late-afternoon light through stone tracery, New Haven rooftops below.
dan_college_davenport: Winter in the snowy Georgian-brick Davenport College courtyard: Dan in a navy Davenport College sweater and a striped knit scarf leaps mid-snowball-fight, snow flying, a lopsided snowman with a Yale cap behind him, bright blue sky and white columns.
dan_college_grace_hopper: A 1940s-style computing lab: Dan in a navy Grace Hopper College sweater and a small navy officer's cap sits at a room-sized vintage computer covered in toggle switches, vacuum tubes and patch cables, peering through a magnifying glass at a tiny moth on a relay (the famous 'first bug'), warm tube glow.
dan_college_jonathan_edwards: Night in the lantern-lit Jonathan Edwards College courtyard: Dan in a navy Jonathan Edwards College sweater sits nose to nose with a friendly, plush cartoon spider (the JE mascot) dangling from a silvery web strung between ivy-covered stone arches; both look delighted; soft lantern light and a few fireflies.
dan_college_morse: The modernist rough-concrete courtyard of Morse College with its tall angular towers: Dan in a navy Morse College sweater taps an antique brass telegraph key on a small wooden table, a long paper tape of dots and dashes curling to the ground, headphones around his neck, crisp clear daylight.
dan_college_pierson: A sunny summer afternoon on the green lawn of Pierson College's Georgian red-brick lower court: Dan in a navy Pierson College polo sweater lines up a croquet shot with a mallet in his mouth, colorful croquet balls and wickets in the grass, white cupola behind him, lemonade on a little table.
dan_college_saybrook: An intramural soccer game on a muddy field after rain: Dan in a navy Saybrook College jersey, splattered with mud, celebrates a goal with a joyful bark, soccer ball bouncing in the net behind him, teammates in navy cheering in the background, dramatic sunset sky.
dan_college_timothy_dwight: Midnight at the Timothy Dwight College snack bar (the buttery): Dan in a navy Timothy Dwight College hoodie stands on a step stool at a griddle, proudly making a gooey grilled cheese sandwich, string lights, a chalkboard menu with doodles but no readable words, cozy late-night glow.
dan_college_trumbull: A cozy Gothic library alcove next to Trumbull College: Dan in a navy Trumbull College cardigan naps contentedly in a big leather armchair under a tall stained-glass window casting colored light, reading glasses slipping down his nose, one open book resting on his paws, a green banker's lamp glowing.
